composio-toolkit-zoho_books.description: Composio toolkit gateway: Zoho Books (zoho_books) - Zoho Books handles accounting, invoicing, and expense tracking, offering real-time collaboration and integrations within the Zoho ecosystem

composio-toolkit-zoho_desk.description: Composio toolkit gateway: Zoho Desk (zoho_desk) - Zoho Desk is a context-aware helpdesk platform enabling support teams to track tickets, automate workflows, and gain insights on customer interactions

composio-toolkit-zoho_inventory.description: Composio toolkit gateway: Zoho Inventory (zoho_inventory) - Zoho Inventory helps businesses track stock, manage orders, and sync inventory across multiple sales channels, streamlining supply chain operations

composio-toolkit-zoho_invoice.description: Composio toolkit gateway: Zoho Invoice (zoho_invoice) - Zoho Invoice simplifies billing, recurring payments, and expense management, helping freelancers and small businesses send professional invoices

composio-toolkit-zoho_mail.description: Composio toolkit gateway: Zoho Mail (zoho_mail) - Zoho Mail is a secure and ad-free email hosting platform with collaboration tools, calendar integration, and extensive administrative controls

composio-toolkit-zoom.description: Composio toolkit gateway: Zoom (zoom) - Zoom is a video conferencing and online meeting platform featuring breakout rooms, screen sharing, and integrations with various enterprise tools

composio-toolkit-zoominfo.description: Composio toolkit gateway: Zoominfo (zoominfo) - ZoomInfo is a go-to-market intelligence platform that provides AI-powered B2B data and sales intelligence to help GTM teams find in-market buyers, build pipeline, and close deals faster.

composio-toolkit-zulip.description: Composio toolkit gateway: Zulip (zulip) - Chat for distributed teams. Zulip combines the immediacy of real-time chat with an email threading model.

composio-toolkit-zylvie.description: Composio toolkit gateway: Zylvie (zylvie) - High-converting cart software for solopreneurs to sell digital products and subscriptions.

composio-toolkit-zyte_api.description: Composio toolkit gateway: Zyte Api (zyte_api) - Zyte API is a web scraping solution that automates data extraction from websites, handling challenges like bans and dynamic content.
